title: The Story of the Lost Sheep
bigIdea: God cares about every single one of us.

memoryVerse.text: There will be great joy in heaven when even one lost person comes home to God.

moral.lesson: Jesus is like the good shepherd. He loves every single person, and He goes looking for anyone who is lost or far away. When even one person comes back to Him, all of heaven throws a party!
moral.application: You matter so much to God. If you ever feel lost, alone, or far away, remember — Jesus is always looking for you, and He is so happy when you are close to Him.

style: Flat-color children's cartoon storybook illustration, simple rounded shapes, soft warm colors, thick clean black outlines, bright and friendly, gentle lighting, 16:9 landscape composition, no text or words in the image, no letters.

characters.jesus: Jesus, a gentle man with brown hair and a short beard, wearing a cream and blue robe
characters.shepherd: a kind young shepherd with short brown hair and a short brown beard, wearing a simple olive-green robe and brown sandals, holding a wooden shepherd's staff

beats.scene: Jesus sits outdoors on a grassy hillside, talking warmly and gesturing to a small group of ordinary grown-ups and children who are listening closely. Soft blue sky, a few fluffy clouds.
text: Crowds of people loved to gather around Jesus and listen to Him. Even people who had made big mistakes wanted to be near Him.
Some of the religious leaders grumbled. “Why does Jesus spend time with people like that?” they said.
So Jesus told them a story to help everyone understand how much God loves them…

beats.scene: The shepherd stands on a green grassy hill surrounded by a large flock of fluffy white sheep under a bright blue sky. He is counting them and looking a little worried, because there is one empty gap where a sheep should be.
text: “Imagine a shepherd who has one hundred sheep,” Jesus said. The shepherd took care of them all day long.
Every evening he counted them to make sure each one was safe: “…ninety-seven, ninety-eight, ninety-nine…”
Oh no! One little sheep was missing! Where could it be?

beats.scene: The shepherd walks alone through rocky hills at golden dusk, holding his wooden staff and searching carefully, looking over rocks and down into a valley for his lost sheep. Warm orange evening sky.
text: Now, the shepherd still had ninety-nine other sheep — but that did not matter. That one lost sheep was so special to him that he had to go and find it.
He made sure the ninety-nine were safe, then climbed over the hills and searched the rocky places, calling out for his little sheep.
It was getting dark, but he would not give up. He kept looking and looking until he found it.

beats.scene: The happy smiling shepherd has found his little white lamb. He gently lifts the small fluffy sheep up onto his shoulders to carry it. Both look joyful and relieved, soft green hills and warm sky behind them.
text: At last — there it was! The shepherd found his little lost sheep.
He wasn't angry at all. He was so happy and full of joy!
Gently, he lifted the sheep up onto his shoulders and carried it safely all the way home.

beats.scene: The shepherd celebrates outside his home with a small group of cheerful friends and neighbors. The little white sheep is safe beside him. Everyone is smiling and waving, warm and joyful, with a sunny sky.
text: When he got home, the shepherd called all his friends and neighbors together. “Be happy with me!” he said. “I found my lost sheep!”
Then Jesus said that God is just like that shepherd. God looks for every single one of us. And when even one person comes home to Him, all of heaven is filled with joy!
God cares about every single one of us.
